name: Tropical Smoothie Diamond Pre-Rolls | 1.2g
description:
Pineapple, mango, and a blend of tropical fruit. Sativa-forward, so the high is upbeat and creative. One of our most complex flavor profiles — the terpene blend changes as it burns. Good for sessions where you want to stay sharp.

Key terpenes: Limonene, Myrcene, Caryophyllene

Infused with Liquid Diamonds: THC-A diamonds liquified for a clean, high-potency infusion. Clean, clear-headed potency — no muddled high.
